name: JBLE-Langley
description: Home to Air Combat Command headquarters and the 633d Air Base Wing. A key East Coast fighter and command base in the Hampton Roads region supporting ACC and joint operations.

currentNotifications.title: Gate Access Reminders
currentNotifications.body: LaSalle Gate (Main) and Armistead Gate are primary 24/7 access points. Visitor Control Center at LaSalle Gate open 0700-1700 daily. REAL ID required.

gates.name: LaSalle Gate (Main Gate)
gates.notes: Primary gate with Visitor Control Center (Bldg 5). Daily 0700-1700 for visitor processing and passes.
gates.address: LaSalle Gate, Langley AFB, Hampton, VA 23665

gates.name: Armistead Gate (West)
gates.notes: 24/7 alternate access point. Useful for off-hours arrivals.
gates.address: Armistead Gate, Langley AFB, Hampton, VA 23665

gates.name: King Street Gate

gates.address: Bldg 5, outside LaSalle Gate, Langley AFB, Hampton, VA 23665

events.title: Crossbow Nationcon FX Class
events.description: Learn beginner-friendly special effects and character makeup techniques, from gory zombie wounds to bold character transformations. Perfect for Halloween season, conventions, and anyone who wants to level up their costume game. Each attendee walks away with their own brand new Mehron Body Paint 8-color mini palette, plus brush and sponges, ready to keep creating long after class ends. Presented by: Breana Cooke & Anja Yamaji Allergy alert: this class involves applying liquid latex directly to the skin, so attendees with latex allergies should take note. To register: https://www.signupgenius.co

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: PCS orders, CAC, medical/dental records. REAL ID or equivalent required for base access. Sponsor required for visitors without DoD ID.

sections.title: In-Processing Schedule
sections.body: Report to gaining unit normal business hours (Mon-Fri 0730-1630). After-hours arrivals report to Langley Inn (757-764-4667). Single members contact CDMO at 37 Cedar Ave — do not sign into lodging if assigned to dorms.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Langley Inn for temporary lodging. Hunt Military Communities for privatized on-base housing (757-920-7100). CDMO at 757-764-4090 for dorms.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: 633 FSS, M&FRC, and official JBLE sites for in-processing and community support.

sections.title: Sponsor Program
sections.body: Your sponsor should meet you upon arrival. Contact M&FRC if no sponsor is assigned before departure.
